title: The composition isomorphism of pushforwards is monoidal
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category (for
instance $\mathcal A=\Ab$), and let $f\colon X\to Y$, $g\colon Y\to Z$ be morphisms of
schemes. The composition isomorphism $g_*\circ f_*\cong(g\circ f)_*$ of pushforwards
of $\mathcal A$-valued pro-étale sheaves
([sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback]), induced by the canonical isomorphisms
$(V\times_ZY)\times_YX\cong V\times_ZX$, is a monoidal natural isomorphism for the
composite lax monoidal structure on $g_*\circ f_*$ and the tensor product of
[sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor].

proof.text:
The tensor product of sheaves is the sheafification of the objectwise tensor product
of presheaves ([sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]). Both lax monoidal structures, on
$g_*\circ f_*$ and on $(g\circ f)_*$, are the sheafification of the objectwise one,
transported along the base change functors of the sites
([sk-def-sfb-finite-pushforward-pullback]): on sections over $V$ they are the maps
$G(W)\otimes H(W)\to(G\otimes H)(W)$ for $W=(V\times_ZY)\times_YX$ resp.
$W=V\times_ZX$. The composition isomorphism is induced by the pasting isomorphism
$(V\times_ZY)\times_YX\cong V\times_ZX$, which is natural in the sheaves and hence
compatible with these objectwise tensor maps, and with the unit maps. Passing to
sheafifications gives the claim.
